SCRIPT DE PREUVE: /tmp/run_avelune_owned.py
from pathlib import Path
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

cwd, log_path, *command = sys.argv[1:]
owned = {}

def processes():
    rows = {}
    for line in subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-eo', 'pid=,ppid=,lstart=,args='], text=True).splitlines():
        parts = line.split(None, 7)
        if len(parts) == 8:
            rows[int(parts[0])] = (int(parts[1]), ' '.join(parts[2:7]), parts[7])
    return rows

with Path(log_path).open('w') as log:
    runner = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print(f'Runner PID {runner.pid}', flush=True)
    start = time.monotonic()
    while runner.poll() is None:
        table = processes()
        parents = {runner.pid, *owned}
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for pid, row in table.items():
                if row[0] in parents and pid not in parents:
                    parents.add(pid)
                    owned[pid] = row
                    changed = True
        time.sleep(.1)
    result = runner.wait()
print(f'Exit {result}; duration {time.monotonic()-start:.2f}s; descendants tracked {len(owned)}', flush=True)
for pid, row in owned.items():
    current = processes().get(pid)
    if current and current[1:] == row[1:] and any(s in current[2] for s in ('flutter_tester', 'frontend_server', 'flutter_tools.snapshot test')):
        print(f'Reaping owned test descendant {pid}', flush=True)
        try:
            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            continue
        time.sleep(.2)
        current = processes().get(pid)
        if current and current[1:] == row[1:]:
            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
print(Path(log_path).read_text()[-6500:])
sys.exit(result)

SCRIPT DE PREUVE: /tmp/uwu3-usages-measure.dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:map_authoring/map_authoring_local.dart';
import 'package:map_core/map_core.dart';

import '/Users/karim/Project/pokemonProject/apps/avelune_studio/test/support/resource_stress_fixture.dart';
import 'package:avelune_studio/features/resources/data/local_resource_usage_adapter.dart';
import 'package:avelune_studio/features/resources/domain/resource_usage_port.dart';
import '/Users/karim/Project/pokemonProject/tools/performance/benchmark_support.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  stdout.writeln(jsonEncode({'kind': 'environment', 'sdk': Platform.version,
    'os': Platform.operatingSystemVersion, 'rssBytes': ProcessInfo.currentRss,
    'mode': 'dart-jit', 'threshold': 'none; descriptive local measures',
    'fixture': 'ResourceStressFixture, existing generator, 200 diagnostics retained',
    'configuration': 'temporary resource-only projects with Pokemon explicitly disabled',
    'scales': {'S': 8, 'M': 132, 'L': 512}, 'warmSamples': 3}));
  for (final scale in {'S': 8, 'M': 132, 'L': 512}.entries) {
    final fixture = await ResourceStressFixture.create(atlasCount: scale.value);
    try {
      final manifest = fixture.manifest.copyWith(pokemon: const ProjectPokemonConfig(
        enabled: false, ruleset: PokemonRulesetProfile.pokeMapBetaV1));
      await File('${fixture.directory.path}/project.json').writeAsString(jsonEncode(manifest.toJson()));
      final manifestBytes = await File('${fixture.directory.path}/project.json').length();
      final mapBytes = await Future.wait(manifest.maps.map((entry) => File(
        '${fixture.directory.path}/${entry.relativePath}').length()));
      final reader = MeasuredUsageReader();
      final profiles = <ProjectSnapshotLoadProfile>[];
      final port = LocalResourceUsageAdapter(session: fixture.session, reader: reader,
        profileSink: profiles.add);
      try {
        final target = ResourceUsageTarget(family: 'images', id: fixture.lateAtlasId);
        final cold = Stopwatch()..start();
        final report = await port.analyze(target);
        cold.stop();
        if (!report.complete) {
          stdout.writeln(jsonEncode({'kind': 'result', 'scale': scale.key,
            'status': 'NON VERIF', 'issues': report.coverageIssues}));
          continue;
        }
        final coldCounts = reader.counts();
        final warm = <int>[];
        final samples = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
        for (var index = 0; index < 3; index++) {
          reader.reset();
          final timer = Stopwatch()..start();
          final next = await port.analyze(target);
          timer.stop();
          if (!next.complete || next.revision != report.revision) {
            throw StateError('The measured fixture changed.');
          }
          warm.add(timer.elapsedMicroseconds);
          samples.add({'us': timer.elapsedMicroseconds, ...reader.counts(),
            'cacheHit': profiles.last.cacheHit});
        }
        reader.reset();
        final verify = Stopwatch()..start();
        final current = await port.isCurrent(report);
        verify.stop();
        stdout.writeln(jsonEncode({'kind': 'result', 'scale': scale.key,
          'status': 'MEASURED', 'maps': manifest.maps.length,
          'tilesets': manifest.tilesets.length, 'elements': manifest.elements.length,
          'diagnostics': fixture.errorCount, 'atlasCount': fixture.atlasCount,
          'manifestBytes': manifestBytes, 'mapsBytes': mapBytes.fold(0, (a, b) => a + b),
          'totalMapCells': fixture.maps.values.fold(0, (a, map) => a + map.size.width * map.size.height),
          'reportEntries': report.entries.length,
          'revision': report.revision, 'cold': {'us': cold.elapsedMicroseconds, ...coldCounts},
          'warm': {'percentiles': percentileFields(warm), 'samples': samples},
          'freshness': {'us': verify.elapsedMicroseconds, 'current': current, ...reader.counts()},
          'rssBytes': ProcessInfo.currentRss}));
      } finally {
        await port.dispose();
      }
    } finally {
      await fixture.dispose();
    }
  }
}

final class MeasuredUsageReader implements ProjectFileReader, ProjectDirectoryReader,
    ProjectSnapshotCacheIdentityReader, ProjectResourceProbeReader {
  final delegate = const LocalProjectFileReader();
  int reads = 0;
  int bytes = 0;
  int identities = 0;
  int directories = 0;
  int probes = 0;
  int binaryReads = 0;
  void reset() { reads = bytes = identities = directories = probes = binaryReads = 0; }
  Map<String, Object?> counts() => {'reads': reads, 'bytes': bytes,
    'identityReads': identities, 'directoryReads': directories,
    'probes': probes, 'binaryReads': binaryReads};
  @override
  Future<String> canonicalizeDirectory(String path) => delegate.canonicalizeDirectory(path);
  @override
  Future<List<String>> listFiles({required String projectRoot, required String relativeDirectory}) {
    directories++;
    return delegate.listFiles(projectRoot: projectRoot, relativeDirectory: relativeDirectory);
  }
  @override
  Future<ProjectResourceIdentity?> readIdentity({required String projectRoot, required String relativePath}) {
    identities++;
    return delegate.readIdentity(projectRoot: projectRoot, relativePath: relativePath);
  }
  @override
  Future<ProjectResourceProbe> probeResource({required String projectRoot, required String relativePath}) {
    probes++;
    return delegate.probeResource(projectRoot: projectRoot, relativePath: relativePath);
  }
  @override
  Future<List<int>> readBytes({required String projectRoot, required String relativePath}) async {
    reads++;
    if (relativePath.endsWith('.png') || relativePath.endsWith('.blob')) binaryReads++;
    final result = await delegate.readBytes(projectRoot: projectRoot, relativePath: relativePath);
    bytes += result.length;
    return result;
  }
}

SCRIPT DE PREUVE: /tmp/uwu4-evidence-collector.py
import datetime
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import tarfile

root = pathlib.Path('/Users/karim/Project/pokemonProject')
baseline = pathlib.Path('/tmp/uwu4-baseline-snapshot')
pack = root / 'documentation/reports/avelune_studio/uwu4_resources'
pack.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), *args], capture_output=True,
                          text=True, check=True).stdout

with tarfile.open('/tmp/uwu4-local-base/working_tree.tar.gz') as archive:
    name = next(name for name in archive.getnames()
                if name.endswith('_uwu4_initial_state.json'))
    initial = json.load(archive.extractfile(name))

status = git('status', '--short', '--untracked-files=all')
paths = set(line[3:] for line in status.splitlines())
paths.update(entry['path'] for entry in initial['files'])
changed = []
for name in sorted(paths):
    if name.startswith('documentation/reports/'):
        continue
    current, before = root / name, baseline / name
    new = current.read_bytes() if current.is_file() else None
    old = before.read_bytes() if before.is_file() else None
    if new == old:
        continue
    try:
        new_text = new.decode('utf-8') if new is not None else ''
        old_text = old.decode('utf-8') if old is not None else ''
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected binary source delta: ' + name)
    changed.append((name, old_text, new_text))

inventory, delta, annex = [], [], []
for name, old, new in changed:
    patch = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),
                    new.splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile='baseline/' + name,
                    tofile='final/' + name, n=3))
    zones = [line.strip() for line in patch.splitlines() if line.startswith('@@')]
    inventory.append({'path': name, 'lines': len(new.splitlines()),
                      'sha256': hashlib.sha256(new.encode()).hexdigest(),
                      'baselineSha256': hashlib.sha256(old.encode()).hexdigest()
                          if (baseline / name).is_file() else None,
                      'zones': zones})
    delta.append(patch)
    annex.append('\n' + '=' * 80 + '\n' + name + '\n' + '=' * 80 + '\n' + new)

(pack / 'inventaire.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory, ensure_ascii=False,
                                              indent=2) + '\n')
(pack / 'delta_local.txt').write_text('BASE REELLE: HEAD archive + modifications locales initiales.\n'
                                   + '\n'.join(delta))
(pack / 'source_annex.txt').write_text('CONTENU INTEGRAL DES SOURCES DU DELTA LOT 4.\n'
                                    'Rapport, journaux et captures exclus pour eviter la recursion.\n'
                                    + ''.join(annex))
logs = []
for log in sorted(pathlib.Path('/tmp').glob('uwu4*.log')):
    logs.append('\n' + '=' * 80 + '\n' + str(log) + '\n' + '=' * 80 + '\n'
                + log.read_text(errors='replace'))
for script in ['/tmp/run_avelune_owned.py', '/tmp/uwu3-usages-measure.dart',
               '/tmp/uwu4-evidence-collector.py']:
    p = pathlib.Path(script)
    if p.is_file():
        logs.append('\nSCRIPT DE PREUVE: ' + script + '\n' + p.read_text())
(pack / 'journaux_consolides.txt').write_text(''.join(logs))
initial_status = initial['status']
if not isinstance(initial_status, str):
    initial_status = '\n'.join(initial_status)
final = ('Captured UTC: ' + datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
         + '\nHEAD: ' + git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') + 'BRANCH: '
         + git('branch', '--show-current') + '\nINITIAL STATUS\n' + initial_status
         + '\nINITIAL CACHED DIFF\n' + initial['cachedDiff']
         + '\nINITIAL DIFF SHA256\n' + initial['diffSha256']
         + '\nFINAL STATUS\n' + status + '\nFINAL CACHED DIFF\n'
         + git('diff', '--cached') + '\nFINAL OVERALL DIFF STAT\n'
         + git('diff', '--stat') + '\nDELTA LOT4 SOURCE FILES\n'
         + '\n'.join(entry['path'] for entry in inventory) + '\n')
(pack / 'etat_git.txt').write_text(final)
print(json.dumps({'sourceFiles': len(inventory), 'newMarkdown': 0,
                  'pack': str(pack), 'annexBytes': (pack / 'source_annex.txt').stat().st_size,
                  'logBytes': (pack / 'journaux_consolides.txt').stat().st_size}))
